simple.meaning: יָשׁוּב (Yâshûwb) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jashub , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יָשׁוּב (H3437) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 26:24, with occurrences in Numbers, 1 Chronicles, Ezra.
